from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,math,statistics,datetime
session=Path('/workspace/scratch/7e3d2a445c44')
root=session/'sf6-metadata-generations'
q=root/'tests/fixtures/metadata-generations/qualification'
source=session/'project6-metadata-generations-performance.ordinal-first'
report=json.loads((source/'report.json').read_text())
assert report['status']=='completed' and len(report['commands'])==15
assert len(report['chronologicalSamples'])==2400
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def distribution(values):
 ordered=sorted(values);size=len(ordered)
 return {'count':size,'median':statistics.median(ordered),'p95':ordered[math.ceil(size*.95)-1],
         'p99':ordered[math.ceil(size*.99)-1],'min':ordered[0],'max':ordered[-1]}
def close(left,right):
 assert math.isclose(left,right,rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-12),(left,right)
raw=[];workloads={};memory=[]
for command in report['commands']:
 assert command['process']['exitCode']==0 and command['process']['signal'] is None
 result=command['result'];assert result['status'] in ['prepared','passed']
 for sample in result['chronologicalSamples']:
  assert sample['guard']=='passed'
  close(sample['microsecondsPerOperation'],sample['elapsedMs']*1000/sample['operations'])
  raw.append((command['label'],sample))
 for row in result['results']:
  assert len(row['warmups'])==20 and len(row['samples'])==100
  for phase,samples in [('warmup',row['warmups']),('measured',row['samples'])]:
   assert [s['batch'] for s in samples]==list(range(len(samples)))
   assert all(s['phase']==phase and s['operations']==row['operationsPerBatch'] for s in samples)
  stats=distribution([s['microsecondsPerOperation'] for s in row['samples']])
  for name,value in stats.items():close(value,row['statistics'][name])
  workloads[(command['label'],row['id'])]=stats
  heaps=[s['nodeHeapDeltaBytes'] for s in row['samples']]
  memory.append({'child':command['label'],'workload':row['id'],'measuredNetHeapBytes':distribution(heaps),
                 'negativeBatches':sum(n<0 for n in heaps),'operationsPerBatch':row['operationsPerBatch']})
assert len(workloads)==20 and len(raw)==2400
for index,((child,sample),retained) in enumerate(zip(raw,report['chronologicalSamples'])):
 assert retained['sequence']==index and retained['child']==child and retained['childSequence']==sample['sequence']
 for key,value in sample.items():
  if key!='sequence':assert retained[key]==value
for group in ['defaultComparisons','explicitBudgetComparisons']:
 for row in report[group]:
  name=row['id'];before_side='baseline' if group=='defaultComparisons' else 'candidate'
  after_label=name+'-candidate'+('' if group=='defaultComparisons' else '-bounded')
  after_name=name+('' if group=='defaultComparisons' else '-bounded')
  before=workloads[(name+'-'+before_side,name)];after=workloads[(after_label,after_name)]
  for metric in ['median','p95','p99']:
   expected={'baseline':before[metric],'candidate':after[metric],'delta':after[metric]-before[metric],
             'percent':(after[metric]/before[metric]-1)*100}
   for key,value in expected.items():close(value,row['metrics'][metric][key])
for row in report['newFeatures']:
 assert row['statistics']==workloads[('generation-features-candidate',row['id'])]
files=[]
def copy_file(src,dst,label):
 data=src.read_bytes();dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 with dst.open('xb') as out:out.write(data)
 assert dst.read_bytes()==data
 files.append({'source':str(src),'retained':label,'bytes':len(data),'sourceSha256':sha(data),'retainedSha256':sha(dst.read_bytes())})
for src in sorted(source.iterdir()):
 assert src.is_file();copy_file(src,q/'performance-ordinal-first'/src.name,'performance-ordinal-first/'+src.name)
for name in ['performance.execution.json','performance.stdout.txt','performance.stderr.txt']:
 copy_file(session/'metadata-qualification-ordinal-edafb801-first'/name,q/'execution-ordinal-first'/name,'execution-ordinal-first/'+name)
for name,dest in [('metadata-ordinal-baseline-preparation.json','ordinal-baseline-preparation.json'),
                  ('metadata-ordinal-baseline-prepare.py','ordinal-baseline-preparation.py.txt')]:
 copy_file(session/name,q/dest,dest)
record={'schemaVersion':1,'recordedUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'reportSha256':sha((source/'report.json').read_bytes()),'harnessCommit':report['harnessCommit'],
 'baselineCommit':report['sources']['baseline']['head'],'productCommit':report['sources']['candidate']['productCommit'],
 'commands':15,'workloads':20,'warmupBatches':400,'measuredBatches':2000,'chronologicalBatches':2400,
 'measuredOperations':sum(s['operations'] for _,s in raw if s['phase']=='measured'),
 'warmupOperations':sum(s['operations'] for _,s in raw if s['phase']=='warmup'),
 'statisticsRecomputed':'Python statistics.median and sorted nearest-rank ceil(N*p)-1 on all 100 measured batch means per workload; every driver statistic and comparison verified.',
 'statisticsScope':'Microseconds per operation from batch means, not individual-call latency percentiles.',
 'files':files,'retainedBytes':sum(f['bytes'] for f in files),'memory':memory,
 'defaultComparisons':report['defaultComparisons'],'explicitBudgetComparisons':report['explicitBudgetComparisons'],
 'newFeatures':report['newFeatures'],'environment':report['environment'],
 'performanceAcceptance':'Pending independent root review and explicit quantified PR sign-off; this receipt grants no exception.',
 'scriptSha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())}
with (q/'ordinal-performance-retention.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(record,out,indent=2);out.write('\n')
with (q/'ordinal-performance-retention.py.txt').open('xb') as out:out.write(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ['reportSha256','commands','workloads','chronologicalBatches','measuredOperations','warmupOperations','retainedBytes']}))
